lines.text: Peter visited the saints in Lydda and told Aeneas, paralyzed for twelve years, that Jesus Christ heals him.
All in Lydda and Sharon saw Aeneas and turned to the Lord, and in Joppa Dorcas became sick and died.
The disciples sent two men to Peter, and the widows showed him tunics and clothing Dorcas had made.
Peter sent everyone out, knelt and prayed, told Tabitha to get up, and presented her alive to the priests.
Many people in Joppa believed in the Lord, and Peter stayed several days with a tanner named Simon.
